restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 50 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; one 64-byte data block per message from the standard IV, followed by the common SHA-256 padding block (equal inputs give the equal padding block, so a first-data-block collision is a full-message collision). The data block is words 0..15 of the shifted pair (schedule words -10..5 of the generator pair): 16 arbitrary 32-bit words, run through the unmodified SHA-256 schedule recurrence and constants K_i at their original indices i.

Prices: one 50-step target compression is one unit; every other primitive word operation is 1/C with C = 3736 (the organizer reference counting method run at 50 rounds; it gives 2896 at 40). Verifying a found pair is 4 reduced compressions (the data block and the padding block of each of the two messages), charged as one unit each (4 units per found pair), separately from the word operations.

Head (proof Section 2): the shipped program (VOL40 v7e generator, W13 retries 22, pairs shifted back ten schedule words; bit-sliced, 256 lanes; one gate on 256 lanes = one word op, as R40 entry df1f1cd1; per-lane accounting of the generation would add at most 8 bits). Per kept pair 10,493.5 charged ops = (2,620.755 word ops per kept pair = (221,000 generation budget + 256 x 300 per lane + 257,800 control block) / 212) x 4 loads/stores = 10,483.0, x 1/(1 - 0.001) for discards; 2^1.48993 units. Generation = declared budget 221,000 word ops per batch (hard bound, Ledger; measured 150,880-152,017 over 20,000 trials) / kept floor 212 of 256. Inside ops_used: 300 per lane (199 itemized: leading-bit count on the batch-transposed junction difference) and 257,800 per batch (257,698 itemized: 16 control lanes recomputed at word level, 32 tally lanes, best-lane output). A batch halting at the budget or keeping < 212 lanes is discarded and still charged; discard fraction <= 0.001 declared (H-kept-pair-yield).

Landing and tail (proof Section 3): the J36 difference of a shifted pair lands on the target with probability 2^-256 per pair (premise P1, a declared heuristic: the exact full-width rate is the premise, measured jointly to 16 bits on shifted pairs and to 32 bits on the unshifted generator pairs, not a measured fact); from the target the pair collides after step 50 with probability 1 (premise P2, by construction: the shifted schedule difference is silent on words 37..49 and the target cancels the step-36 word difference, so the two computations coincide from the junction on; forced-target implementation check 5,812/5,812, negative control 0/5,812).

Ledger: N = ln(1/0.61) x 2^256 pairs; T = B x (221,000 + 256 x 300 + 257,800) x 4 / 3736 + 4 + 2^28.2 with the FIXED batch count B = ceil(N / (212 x (1 - 0.001))): a deterministic total-work bound (every batch charged at the generation budget plus the per-lane block for all 256 lanes, kept or not, discarded or not, plus the per-batch control block CTRL = 257,800); per kept pair this is 10,493.5 charged operations = 2^1.48993 units; the run stops at the first found pair (4 reduced compressions); the success probability 0.39 includes the chance that more than a 0.001 fraction of the B batches is discarded, bounded by a Chernoff tail below 2^-1000 at the declared per-batch discard probability p <= 2e-4 (measured 0 of 20,000; one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 1.50e-04); log2 T = 256.47338 (exact 256.47337937, rounded up to five decimals).; hard bound: the program halts before a retry if its max cost 1,585 + the max post-loop work 182,649 would pass the budget

Memory by construction (complete under the model): list subsets 357,408 + program code 65,212 + 256-lane sliced working state 216,064 (211 sliced words of 1,024 bytes) + word-level working state 5,776 + current messages 128 = 644,588 bytes (2^19.30, rounded up; term max(0, log2-20) = 0). Preprocessing: 7 list enumerations of 2^32 candidates at <= 24 word operations each = 7 x 2^24.72 compressions = 2^27.53, plus 422 compressions of subset selection; declared 2^28.2 (rounded up; proof Section 5); the per-pair random word draws are charged as word operations.
Premises P1, P2, P3 (independence across pairs) and H-kept-pair-yield are declared heuristics of the exploratory lane (proof Section 6).

heuristics.statement: For shifted pairs output by the shipped program, the 256-bit J36 XOR difference equals the J36 target with probability 2^-256 per pair.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's shifted pairs, standard IV, 50 steps. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (on every trial the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma over its first 32 kept lanes, a wide band at 32 lanes, and fails the trial otherwise; the uniformity evidence is the pooled count over 20,000 trials). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: Shifted pairs of this generator and shift: 36 organizer-format trials (8,749 pairs) k=8 landing 36 (expected 34.2); 24 trials (5,812 pairs) k=8 landing 16 (expected 22.7), k=16 landing 0 (expected 0.09). Pooled over the 21 shifted packages R41-R61 (same generator, 183,497 pairs): k=8 landing 745 (expected 716.8), k=16 landing 4 (expected 2.80); a further 4,704 trials of the same 21 experiments on a second machine (1,138,197 pairs): k=8 landing 4,518 (expected 4,446.1), k=16 landing 14 (expected 17.37); all 1,321,694 pairs together: k=8 landing 5,263 (expected 5,162.9), k=16 landing 18 (expected 20.17). The unshifted VOL40 generator pairs land at 2^-8.00/2^-16.00/2^-23.98/2^-31.83 for k=8/16/24/32 on 2^36 states; per-bit |p-0.5| <= 0.00001; extended to 256 bits under independence of bits. The shipped program over 20,000 organizer-format fresh-seed trials: landing k8 19,075 (expected 18,939.0), k16 98 (74.0), k24 1 (0.29), k32 0 (0.001); bit-match counts 2..29; failed trials 0. Organizer-run evidence: every trial of experiment v50-shift-01 reports landing_k8, landing_k16, landing_k24, landing_k32 and best_lead_bits for its kept pairs; the expected counts are kept x 2^-k, and the per-trial landing_k8 counts give the dispersion test for P3.
heuristics.limitations: Joint landing on shifted pairs is measured to 16 bits (counts above); the 32-bit joint evidence is from the unshifted generator; the step to all 256 bits is the declared premise itself, not a derived bound. Landing-rate check on the pooled shifted k=8 count: 5,263 vs 5,162.9 expected, z = +1.39 (one-sided p 0.08); the unshifted program on 4,331,098 pairs gives z = -0.27. Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.

heuristics.statement: A shifted pair from the shipped program whose J36 difference equals the target collides after step 50 with probability 1.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's shifted pairs at the J36 target. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (on every trial the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma over its first 32 kept lanes, a wide band at 32 lanes, and fails the trial otherwise; the uniformity evidence is the pooled count over 20,000 trials). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: By construction: the shifted schedule difference is silent on words 37..49 and the J36 target cancels the step-36 word difference, so from the junction on the two computations coincide and the pair collides. Implementation check with the target forced on real program states: 5,812/5,812 (24 trials) and 8,749/8,749 (36 trials); negative control (bit 30 of register h) 0 in both; the shipped program asserts this on the first 16 kept lanes of every trial (20,000 fresh-seed trials, 0 failures).
heuristics.limitations: The implementation check uses forced-target states; the probability-1 claim rests on the structural argument.

heuristics.statement: Landing events of distinct pairs are independent.
heuristics.scope: pairs within and across shared batches. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (on every trial the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma over its first 32 kept lanes, a wide band at 32 lanes, and fails the trial otherwise; the uniformity evidence is the pooled count over 20,000 trials). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: Pairs of one batch share the generator words except the retried word, so they are not independent by construction; after the shift no compression step is shared (the first shifted word depends on the retried word), and each organizer trial is one batch of 256 lanes, so the per-trial dispersion tests exactly the within-batch dependence; the VOL40 batch test (64 batches x 512 pairs, dispersion chi-square 65.0 vs 64 +- 11.3) covers the shared generator part. Shifted pairs, the 4,200 second-machine trials whose per-trial outputs were retained (1,016,296 pairs; the other 504 second-machine trials kept only totals, k=8 508 vs 476.2 expected): per-trial k=8 dispersion chi-square 4,197.8 vs 4,199 +- 91.6; this program's 24 trials alone (5,812 pairs): 16.1 vs 23 +- 6.8. The shipped program over 20,000 trials: kept variance 12.80 vs binomial 12.86, ratio 0.995. Organizer-run evidence: the per-trial landing_k8 counts in the trusted report (each trial = one batch of 256 lanes) are the dispersion sample; under P3 their variance equals their mean.
heuristics.limitations: Tested on the landing indicators the program reports; independence of the exact 256-bit event over the full run is the declared premise. Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.

heuristics.statement: Each batch of 256 lanes keeps each lane with probability 0.946 (measured); a batch is discarded, and still charged, if it keeps fewer than 212 lanes or halts at the declared generation budget of 221,000 word operations; the fraction of discarded batches over the run is at most 0.001 (declared). Lane-keeping indicators within a batch are modelled as independent Bernoulli(0.946) (declared; measured kept-per-batch variance 10.14 vs binomial 13.09 over 24 batches, ratio 0.775; 12.80 vs 12.86, ratio 0.995 over 20,000 batches).
heuristics.scope: the shipped program, standard IV, 50 steps, every batch of the run
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured over 24 organizer-format fresh-seed batches: kept per batch mean 242.2, minimum 235, maximum 248; generation 150,880-152,017 word operations per batch; discarded batches 0 of 24; none under the floor. The shipped program over 20,000 further fresh-seed batches: kept minimum 227, mean 242.4; generation 150,880-152,017; discarded or failed trials 0. With B about 2^247.3 batches and a declared per-batch discard probability p <= 2e-4 (0 discarded of 20,000, one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 1.50e-04; every hard-check failure of a batch is a discard and is in the measured count), the probability that more than 0.001 B batches are discarded is below exp(-B x D(0.001 || 2e-4)) < 2^-1000 (D = 0.00081 nats per batch), so the fixed batch count B suffices with the stated success probability. The organizer report lists kept, ops_used, checks_failed and checks_mask for every trial.
heuristics.limitations: The per-lane rate, the independence model and the discard probability bound p <= 2e-4 are declared; the budget and the floor are enforced by the program (a violating batch fails its trial); the Chernoff bound assumes independent batches (fresh organizer seeds per trial). Seeds were fixed before any run and every run is reported.
